review.images: Reviewed the seven Emaar gallery images and wide hero. Used seven distinct scenes after omitting the narrower duplicate promenade render. The dusk towers supply the card, and living and bedroom renders support the editorial section.
review.location: Matched the named Club Point marker and regional Dubai Hills Estate map. Physical brochure page 3 gives the four estimates shown.
review.floorPlans: Used all 46 complete residence sheets across Blocks A, B and C from the 51-page developer PDF. Reviewed the title and area panels visually and used independent PDFium and spatial extraction. The component bounds conflict with printed totals on physical pages 6 (853.08 vs at least 892.33), 29 (825.81 vs at most 824.73) and 40 (1,086.29 vs at least 1,087.48). The printed values remain qualified. Page 37 has a repeated period in the suite figure. Page 4 omits the A in one printed unit code and page 44 includes A1708 within a Block B sheet. The original unit lists are preserved without correction.

unavailable: Corrected source area tables and signed unit-specific measurements were not verified.
